messages:
maria: Quick sync — final version of the launch email + webinar invite. We need: 1) cadence for warm vs cold, 2) who gets webinar invite vs product-demo, 3) suppression windows for recent contacts. Thoughts?
aj: For warm leads (trial activity or demo requested in last 90d) — 3-email cadence over 7 days: Day 0 launch, Day 3 reminder, Day 7 CTA. Subject line variants: "Meet the new Redwood Inference", "Faster LLM inference — live demo". A/B test header & CTA.
devin: +1 to 3-email for warm. For cold (downloaded whitepaper, visited pricing) — 5-email drip over 21 days with educational content. Add behavioral branching: if click -> move to warm path.
sam: We need to pin UTM params and source tags. Make sure support suppression of anyone emailed in last 30 days. Also exclude customers on Dedicated/Private rollout.
lina: Webinar invites: invite all warm + engaged cold (clicked 2+ emails). Send initial invite 10 days before, 2 reminders (3 days, 1 day). Use `utm_campaign=launch_q2_webinar` and tag creative=A/B.
maria: Can someone draft the 3 subject + 3 preview combinations? Also want a short PS with invite link.
aj: I'll draft subjects + CTAs by EOD. Template notes:
```
Subject: <variant>
Preview: 1-liner
CTA: View product demo / Register for webinar
```
devin: For routing: campaign list logic in Braze/HubSpot:
- Warm list: Last activity <90d AND (trial || demo) -> send Launch + webinar
- Cold engaged: clicked >=2 in 21d -> webinar invite
- Cold passive: send educational drip only
Share segments of ~10k max per send to keep deliverability.
sam: Analytics/metrics: open, ctr, reg rate (for webinar), MQL conversions, unsub rate. Put dashboards in Looker.
campaign-bot: Scheduled: Launch email send queued for 2026-04-06T17:00:00Z. Preview send 2026-04-05T17:00:00Z.
maria: Great. Who's owner for suppression list exports and warm vs cold finalization?
aj: Owner (segmentation + copy) = AJ. Owner (deliverability & suppression export) = Sam. Owner (webinar landing + tracking) = Lina. I'll create checklist in Notion and invite reviewers.
lina: I'll own webinar landing + GA events. cc @devin for behavior branching rules.
devin: I'll push the segment filters and the behavioral webhook. Also adding a `do_not_email_last30` flag to segment.
maria: Cool. Next steps: AJ copy by EOD, Sam deliverability export by tomorrow AM, Lina landing + reg form by Wed. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
